items.content_text: SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket has reached Max Q, or maximum dynamic pressure. Max Q marks the moment of peak aerodynamic stress on the rocket. This happens as the vehicle is accelerating and climbing through thick lower atmosphere, creating a peak in the force of air pushing against the rocket’s structure.

items.title: A Light in the Dark
items.content_text: A sliver of the edge of Earth is brightly illuminated against the vast darkness of space.

items.title: Unlocking the Mystery of X-ray Dots
items.content_text: A newly discovered object may be a key to unlocking the true nature of a mysterious class of sources that astronomers have found in the early universe in recent years.

items.title: Building on America’s 65-Year Legacy of Human Spaceflight
items.content_text: America’s first human spaceflight begins as the Mercury-Redstone 3 (MR-3) space vehicle, with astronaut Alan B. Shepard Jr. aboard, launches from Cape Canaveral, Florida on May 5, 1961.

items.title: Hubble Spots a Starry Spiral
items.content_text: This NASA Hubble Space Telescope image features the glittering spiral galaxy NGC 3137, located 53 million light-years away in the constellation Antlia (the Air Pump).

items.title: NASA Artemis II Crew Rings Nasdaq Closing Bell
items.content_text: Nasdaq Chair and Chief Executive Officer Adena T. Friedman, left, and NASA’s Artemis II crew ring the closing bell of the Nasdaq market session, Thursday, April 30, 2026.

items.title: Artemis III Rocket Core Stage Moves to NASA Kennedy
items.content_text: NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) core stage for the Artemis III mission moves into the Vehicle Assembly Building at the agency's Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Tuesday, April 28, 2026.

items.title: A Gently Glowing Galaxy
items.content_text: The barred spiral galaxy IC 486 glows with a soft, ethereal light in this NASA Hubble Space Telescope image.

items.title: Science in Space
items.content_text: Expedition 74 flight engineers Chris Williams of NASA and Sophie Adenot of the European Space Agency work together in the Kibo laboratory module’s Life Science Glovebox.

items.title: NASA's X-59 Gets Freedom 250 Logo
items.content_text: The X-59’s tail and jet engine feature a new marking — a Freedom 250 logo celebrating the nation’s 250th birthday in 2026.

items.title: The Day of the Trifid Nebula
items.content_text: NASA celebrates Hubble’s 36th anniversary with a new image of the Trifid Nebula, a star-forming region it first captured in 1997. The telescope leveraged almost its full operational lifetime to show us changes in the nebula on human time scales with an improved camera.
